name: What is the typical cost structure for commercial general contracting services?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost structure for commercial general contracting services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost structure for commercial general contracting services typically involves either a fixed-price contract, a cost-plus contract, or a guaranteed maximum price (GMP). A fixed-price contract offers a single lump sum, while cost-plus charges for actual expenses plus a negotiated fee. GMP sets an upper limit for costs, offering a balance of transparency and risk mitigation. The best approach depends on project scope, complexity, and desired cost control. Opus Builders provides transparent estimates based on detailed project specifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost structures include fixed-price, cost-plus, or guaranteed maximum price (GMP), varying based on project scope and desired cost control.
